## Fixes
- The deck stopped refreshing after a few hours when a key was left selected in the settings window, most visibly on pages with plugin keys. On macOS 26, a segmented picker loses a little memory every time it is redrawn; the settings panel was redrawn on every plugin update, so the window's layout grew slower and slower until it took all of the app's time. The two segmented pickers of the panel are now redrawn only when their choice changes. - Copying a plugin key and pasting it on the same page closed the app. The pasted key now gets its own identity for the plugin, and keeps the settings of the original.

## Fix
- Live data: a number written without a leading zero, such as `.2`, was read as `2`. It is now read as `0.2`. This is how `bc` prints small values, so a command using it showed values ten times too large.

## Several actions in a row
A key can now run a list of actions in order. Under **Action**, choose **Several actions in a row**, add the steps, reorder them with the arrows, and set the pause between them. If a step fails, the rest is not run.
The action a key already had becomes the first step, so nothing is lost when you switch.
